WebRtcSignalingSession.title: WebRtcSignalingSession
WebRtcSignalingSession.description: Ephemeral WebRTC signaling session for pairing Android phone and PC without storing any library content.

sessionId.description: High-entropy random session identifier derived from pairing code.

pairingCodeDigest.description: Verification digest of the temporary pairing code.

hostDeviceRole.description: Role of the initiator device (phone-primary or pc-companion).

offerSdp.description: WebRTC SDP Offer string (network negotiation only, zero library content).

answerSdp.description: WebRTC SDP Answer string (network negotiation only, zero library content).

hostCandidatesJson.description: Bounded JSON array of ICE candidates from host device.

peerCandidatesJson.description: Bounded JSON array of ICE candidates from joining device.

expiresAtMs.description: Expiration epoch timestamp in milliseconds (max 10 minutes after creation).

updatedAtMs.description: Last signaling update timestamp in milliseconds.

/webrtc_signaling_sessions/{sessionId}.description: Temporary signaling documents used exclusively for WebRTC SDP and ICE negotiation between Phone and PC.
